text:
Ana: Quick sync - finalizing the May 10 webinar: "Serving LLMs at Product Scale". Need to confirm: live time (we're leaning 9am PT / 12pm ET), rehearsal slot, recording + captions workflow, and the lead-routing payload. Thoughts?
Mike: 9am PT works for me. Better for EU folks hopping on early.
Sylvia: Also good. I'll own captions + assets. Planning Otter auto-transcript + manual QC next day. Need a consent slide at start.
Jenna: Speakers: Jenna (runtime/ops), Priya (customer ROI), Tom (benchmarks). I need a mic check and 30m for slides + 20m demo dry run during rehearsal.
Priya: Can do. I'll prep 2 ROI bullets and one customer screenshot.
Tom: I'll bring the benchmark highlights and one short chart comparing latency/cost tradeoffs.
Devon: Routing rules reminder: enterprise-intent leads -> enterprise-high queue; demo requests -> webinar-sdr. Use a unique utm_campaign so ops can filter. Example webhook snippet (ops-friendly): 
```
{
  "utm_campaign": "serve-llm-may10",
  "lead_source": "webinar",
  "tags": ["webinar","serve-llm","interest"],
  "route": "enterprise-high"
}
```
Sam: Upload final deck to /marketing/webinars/serve-llm/ by Tue EOD. Also put pre-recorded demo clip in /marketing/webinars/serve-llm/assets as fallback. Moderator script should include a 30s fallback transition.
Ana: Proposed rehearsal windows: Tue 3pm PT or Wed 11am PT. Jenna prefers Wed 11am PT. Anyone opposed?
Jenna: Wed 11am PT confirmed. Please include 20 minutes for the demo smoke test.
Mike: I'll draft short promo copy and a 2-line blurb for the email invite. Target send for initial announcement is Tue morning.
Sylvia: Caption workflow: Otter -> export VTT -> manual QC by @Sylvia -> upload alongside recording. Turnaround target = next business day.
Devon: I'll set up the webhook in sales ops and map the route field to AE queue "enterprise-high". Also adding a lead tag: serve-llm-may10.
Priya: For the customer slide, can someone pull PV numbers (TTV / cost savings) from the customer success doc? @Sam?
Sam: I'll add the PV numbers and upload demo artifacts today. Also adding a smoke-test checklist to the assets directory.
Ana: Decisions: time = 12pm ET (9am PT); rehearsal = Wed 11am PT; deck due Tue EOD; captions = Otter + manual QC; utm_campaign = serve-llm-may10; routing as Devon outlined. I'll lock calendar and create Zoom.
zoom-bot: Meeting created: "Serve LLMs at Product Scale - Rehearsal" Wed 11:00 PT. Invites sent.
Mike: Draft promo copy uploaded to thread (file).
Sylvia: Will run an Otter caption test during rehearsal and note timestamps for QC.
Devon: Routing rules doc posted in sales-ops and pinged @sales-leads.
Ana: I'll post the run-of-show here shortly. Please mark any conflicts now. :thumbsup:
Tom: No conflicts. Looking forward to it.
Jenna: All set on my side. See you Wed.
Ana: Closing thread  action items: Sam upload assets, Devon map webhook, Sylvia caption workflow, Mike promo copy, Ana to update run-of-show. Thanks!
